name: Feasibility: User management
description:
Owners per PRD: Partnership team, Addons team.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Registration, login, password recovery
- Email verification
- Roles and permissions system
- Add / remove users under a company account
- Account information editing
- Multilingual support (CZ / SK / HU / EN)

This is the foundation all other feature areas depend on — analyse it first.

h2. To analyse

- Reuse of existing Shoptet identity/auth vs. new one — can partners log in with an existing Shoptet account as the PRD assumes?
- Where does the company ↔ user relationship live (Salesforce, internal CRM), and who is master?
- Roles & permissions model needed across partner types (consulting, affiliate, add-on dev) and how it relates to Partner Role in admin
- Access management when expanding to more countries (OQ-02)
- i18n approach for 4 locales

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
